NONE: › existing in a wild state, especially describing an animal that was previously kept by people

釀葡萄酒是讓葡萄汁發酵，直到所有的糖分都轉化為酒精。

總統辭職導致國家陷入動亂之中。

激烈的戰鬥

NONE: › a small, yellowish-white animal with a long body, bred for hunting rabbits and other small animals

I + adv/prep: › [ I + adv/prep ] UK to search for something by moving things around with your hands, especially in a drawer, bag, or other closed space
（尤指在抽屜、袋子等中）搜尋，翻找
I: › [ I ] to search for something or someone, by looking in many places or asking many questions

example: I was just ferreting around in my drawer for my passport.
我當時正在翻抽屜找我的護照。
After a bit of ferreting, I managed to find his address.
四處搜尋了一會兒後，我找到了他的地址。

NONE: › to find out a piece of information or find someone or something, after looking in many places or asking many questions
搜尋出，搜索出

example: [ + question word ] I know his name but I haven't managed to ferret out where he lives.
我知道他的名字，不過我還沒有查出他住在哪裡。

NONE: › a large, vertical wheel in an amusement park with seats that stay horizontal as the wheel turns round
摩天輪，大轉輪

› containing or relating to iron
含鐵的；鐵的

U: › (of animals and plants) the quality of being able to produce young or fruit

› literary (of the mind or imagination) the quality of producing a lot of unusual and interesting ideas
